_comment: Defect declarations for the support replay clip (demos/support_demo.json); see demos/README.md, Sidecar declarations. Uid 9's facing_flutter exemption (#1854) is gone: uid 9 passes on every one of seeds 0 to 4 since #1880 (ea0a9029 and eb8b0995: dense 2-tick FULL dumps, every exemption removed, Windows, 2026-10-31; 9f9bddee read 4.00, 4.00, 4.00, 4.00, 4.00, against 3; ea0a9029 reads 2 on every seed, and eb8b0995 passes every seed), so it is no longer exempted.

overlap.reason: Team 1's Infantry (uid 6) reaches melee contact at the end of the clip (its count drops 120 -> 117 by tick 780) and compresses into the press: CI website demo-diff on PR #1677 measured a minimum neighbour distance of 1.318 wu against the 2.25 wu floor, merge-base 6.89, where contact came earlier and the sampled ticks missed it. Press-adjacent compression at contact, not standing interpenetration. Uid 9, overlap: Dense 2-tick FULL dumps, every exemption removed, Windows, seeds 0 to 4: 9f9bddee reads pass on every seed; eb8b0995 (#1880) reads 0.56 on every seed, against 5.0. The seed barely perturbs this replay clip (seeds 0, 1, 3 and 4 read 0.5595 to the last digit, seed 2 0.5647), so the five readings are nearly one run. Traced on the clip seed on ea0a9029 (eb8b0995's dense seed-0 dump is hash-identical to that of 1498634e, which has ea0a9029's sim): the 80-horse cavalry squadron marches on an ATTACK out of contact and turns its heading about 60 degrees between ticks 500 and 510 (9f9bddee: between 470 and 480), after which its riders spread off their slots (farthest 80 wu at tick 660, against at most 50 on 9f9bddee); walking back, riders 6 and 7, 17 and 57 wu off their slots, pass within 0.56 wu of each other at tick 710. This change does not alter the squadron's own steering there: it never takes the share of the march's acceleration (an ATTACK is not an orderly march), its arrival-target ramp runs only on its opening march (ticks 21 to 70), and with the ramp switched off on every march but an orderly one it reads the same 0.56. The one block in the clip that takes the share is uid 1, on its orderly marches from tick 140 to 651, which changes the battle the squadron meets. Rerun with body_accel scaled by 1 + k * 1e-6 (k = 1 to 16, a nudge that favours no mechanism) to tell a defect from chance: 9f9bddee fails uid 9's overlap on 1 of 16 runs (1.41 wu, with a shape residual of 441.9), eb8b0995 on 5 of 16 (0.35 to 0.58 wu), and eb8b0995 with the share switched off on 0 of 12. So the crossing is pre-existing, and uid 1's march makes the battle meet it more often: riders of a squadron crossing while it re-forms after a heading turn on its march, out of contact and with no new order (#1894). Measured 2026-10-31.

shape_residual.reason: Team 1's cavalry squadron (uid 8, 9 ranks, 960 wu deep) now deploys with its front rank on its line and marches a long diagonal toward its target, so the deep block spends the clip mid-turn and its rear ranks trail its grid: the same deep-block mid-turn mechanism declared for uid 8 in cycle-charge.json (#1546). CI website demo-diff on PR #1677: worst 77.78 wu against the 30 wu floor, merge-base 3.199.
